sources.title: Freeport says Indonesia's Grasberg mine ramp-up on track after mudslide disruption
evidence: Freeport-McMoRan (NYSE: FCX) said on Friday progress at its Grasberg Block Cave underground mine in Indonesia is on track for a phased ramp-up, as the miner undertakes recovery efforts following a deadly mudslide that disrupted operations last year.
The company, whose shares rose 3.2% in morning trading, expects to reach 80% of capacity in mid-2027 and approach full capacity by year-end 2027.

Upgrades to the material handling system at the Grasberg Block Cave haulage level are progressing toward completion by early 2027, while preparations continue for the targeted restart of production from Production Block 1S by mid-2027, Freeport said.

sources.title: 한국철강 창원공장 제강설비 고장...복구 작업 진행
evidence: 한국철강 창원공장 제강라인에 설비 고장으로 생산 차질이 불가피할 전망이다.
제강라인 가동 중단으로 자체 빌릿 생산에는 차질이 발생했지만, 압연라인은 정상 가동 중이다. 기존에 확보한 빌릿 재고를 활용해 철근 생산을 이어갈 계획이다.
다만 설비 복구가 늦어지거나 보유 빌릿 재고가 소진될 경우 생산에도 차질이 발생할 가능성이 있다.

sources.title: Signs grow that US Trinseo will need more time to exit bankruptcy
evidence: HOUSTON (ICIS)– Trinseo's goal of emerging from bankruptcy protection by the end of 2026 is increasingly at risk as a dispute with dissenting creditors remains unresolved.
In the meantime, the judge instructed the two sides to start mediation to resolve their differences.

The company would like the court to extend the exclusivity period for filing a plan to 22 December from 23 September. For soliciting support for the plan, Trinseo would like the exclusivity period extended to 22 February from 23 November.
Trinseo makes styrene butadiene latex (SB), acrylonitrile butadiene styrene (ABS), polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA) and other engineered materials.

sources.title: G7 countries agree on release of diesel and oil stocks after US pressure
evidence: Group of Seven countries agreed on Friday to release 100 million barrels of diesel and crude oil from emergency reserves and pledged to refrain from energy export restrictions after pressure from US President Donald Trump.
The Iran war sparked the biggest emergency stock release ever of 400 million barrels in March, coordinated by the International Energy Agency.
The release will begin immediately and last four months, with a substantial amount of diesel to be released within 20 days by G7 members and partners, the statement said.

"Europe has a lot of diesel, and they're going to be making a major world contribution, and so are we. And we're not going to be doing the export ban. We're going to be doing what we're supposed to do," Trump said.
